test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_contains_value_subcolumn_perf ( id UInt64, m Map(String, UInt64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS map_serialization_version = 'basic', min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_contains_value_subcolumn_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat('attribute_', hex(cityHash64(number, i)), '_', hex(cityHash64(number, i + 1)), '_', hex(cityHash64(number, i + 2))), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt64(i), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE map_contains_value_subcolumn_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1
test.query: SELECT count() FROM map_contains_value_subcolumn_perf WHERE mapContainsValue(m, toUInt64(15)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1, optimize_functions_to_subcolumns = 1, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_query_condition_cache = 0
